label: late original phase / <DEL> position, boosted when sequence starts with h
explanation: Diffuse positional feature. It fires weakly (median 0.19) at absolute steps t=4..7 in the original phase and at the <DEL> step: the <DEL> step accounts for 34% of mass (active on 25% of <DEL> steps) and original steps 3-8 for most of the rest. It almost never fires at t<=2 or anywhere in the copy phase beyond the first output (copy phase holds 1.5% of mass). Inside that window only about 20% of steps are active, and no token or history variable reliably picks which ones. The strongest modulator of magnitude is the first original token: when the sequence starts with h (often h h ...), precision rises to 0.85 and these steps make up about half of the top activation quartile (max-activating examples are all h-initial, peaking at <DEL>). v-initial sequences and preceding t/m/o/w/p give smaller boosts. The predicate gets the position right (mass recall 0.85) but precision is low (0.21).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: h, v, 2, 3, 1, l; least: t, p, w, a) and the previous input (most: t, m, o, w, <DEL>, p; least: n, l, h, -); timing cues that raise it most: t=6, t=5, t=7.
